function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! The best place to order a cake depends on where you’re located and what kind of cake you’re craving. Here are a few options you can consider: | Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips | |--------|----------------|--------------|------| | **Online cake marketplaces** | • Wide variety of bakeries
• Custom designs & flavors
• Delivery to most addresses | • Go to sites like **Etsy**, **Goldbelly**, **Blue Apron**, or **Amazon Fresh**.
• Search “custom cakes” or “birthday cakes.” | • Check delivery times & shipping fees.
• Read reviews for quality & reliability. | | **Local bakeries with online ordering** | • Fresh, often handmade cakes
• Local flavor & support | • Search “bakery near me” + “online ordering.”
• Many have their own websites or use platforms like **Square Online** or **Shopify**. | • Call ahead to confirm availability.
• Ask about special dietary options (gluten‑free, vegan, etc.). | | **Specialty cake shops** | • Signature cakes (e.g., wedding, themed, artisanal) | • Look up shops like **Baker & Spice**, **Cake Boss**, or local boutique bakeries.
• Many accept orders via email or phone. | • Provide details early (size, theme, deadline). | | **Grocery delivery services** | • Ready‑made cakes from big chains (Whole Foods, Kroger, Safeway) | • Use apps like **Instacart**, **Shipt**, or the store’s own delivery service.
• Pick “cakes” from the bakery section. | • Delivery windows may be limited; order early. | | **Subscription services** | • Monthly cake deliveries (e.g., **The Cake Club**, **Baker’s Dozen**) | • Sign up on their website; choose flavor & frequency. | • Great for regular celebrations or gifts. | ### Quick Steps to Order 1. **Decide the occasion** (birthday, wedding, anniversary, just because). 2. **Choose a style** (classic vanilla, chocolate lava, vegan, gluten‑free, themed). 3. **Pick a vendor**: - If you want something local and fresh, search “bakery near me” + “online ordering.” - If you want a wide selection or a specialty cake, try a marketplace or specialty shop. 4. **Place the order**: - Fill out the online form or call the bakery. - Provide delivery address, date/time, and any special instructions. 5. **Confirm**: - Double‑check the order details. - Ask about payment options and cancellation policy. ### Need a Recommendation? If you tell me your city or zip code, I can look up a few highly rated local bakeries that accept online orders and give you their contact info. Just let me know!
